land.text: Crete, the Venetian Kingdom of Candia

predecessors.note: Venetian feudal lords of the colony rebelled (Kingdom of Candia page).

land.text: Crete, back under Venice after the revolt ended in 1368

successors.note: Venice retook Candia on 9 May 1364; the revolt ended in 1368.

capitals.name: Candia (Heraklion)
capitals.note: My reading: the page names Candia as the place Venice retook on 9 May 1364 and gives the rebels no seat of government.

correction.text: Crete, held by the rebels until Venice retook Candia on 9 May 1364

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The page says Venetian feudal lords rebelled on 9 August 1363 and declared the Republic of Saint Titus, and that Venice retook Candia on 9 May 1364; it does not delimit the rebel area, so the whole island is a reading (confidence 2). Cliopatria draws Crete inside the Republic of Venice throughout 1363-1374.

minus.text: Candia, retaken by Venice on 9 May 1364

correction.text: Crete outside Candia, where the revolt continued until the Kallergis brothers were captured in April 1367

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. After the loss of Candia the revolt went on until 'the Kallergis brothers were captured by treason in April 1367, and the revolt ended in 1368'. Which districts the rebels held in these years is on no page opened (confidence 1: the island outside Candia is a bridging reading).

ledger.note: 9 August 1363: the Venetian feudal lords of Crete declare the Republic of Saint Titus. The page: '9 August 1363 - 1368 (Revolt of St. Titus): Venetian feudal lords rebelled and declared the "Republic of Saint Titus".' The land is my reading (the page names only Candia).

region.text: Candia, retaken by Venice on 9 May 1364
the rest of Crete, held until the revolt ended in 1368

ledger.note: 1368: 'The Kallergis brothers were captured by treason in April 1367, and the revolt ended in 1368.' The district boundaries are not on the page.
1368: the Republic of Saint Titus ends with the revolt.

wars.name: Revolt of St. Titus
wars.outcome: Venice retook Candia on 9 May 1364, captured the Kallergis brothers by treason in April 1367 and ended the revolt in 1368.

certainty.note: The page does not delimit the rebel-held land.

sources.title: Kingdom of Candia
sources.note: The only page used: the Kingdom of Candia article's revolt section (9 August 1363 - 1368). The dedicated article on the revolt was not opened.

sources.title: Revolt of Saint Titus
sources.note: Added by the eu-13-c reviewer: the revolt's own article (infobox August 1363-1364; body: after Candia fell in May 1364 'the entire western part of Crete was in the hands of the insurgents' and they gained 'most of the countryside'; Venetian rule consolidated over the whole island in 1368). It supports the 1365-1368 keyframe.

notes: A rebel state written from one page, the Kingdom of Candia article, because Venice's own ledger needs a counterpart for the loss of Crete in 1363. Unsettled: the extent of the rebel-held land (the page names only Candia), the rebels' seat, the dated stages of 1364-1367, and the Wikipedia title (the article on the revolt exists under a name I did not open; wikipedia and wikidata are null). The whole island is used as the 1363-1364 region, and Crete outside Candia for 1365-1367, both readings. A gap-filler should open the revolt's own article. Written by the eu-13-c batch (Republic of Venice); Cliopatria has no row for it.
